notes: compact_threshold_tokens: total token estimate of .ai-context (CONTEXT.md + STATE.json + log/*.md) that triggers compaction.
keep_recent_tokens: newest logs kept verbatim after compaction; older logs are archived.
chars_per_token: rough estimator used because no tokenizer is guaranteed to be installed.
max_context_md_tokens: budget for the rewritten CONTEXT.md.
max_entry_chars: hard cap per bullet in a log entry.
